card.name: Zero digit inside comma-grouped numbers
card.fires_on: The digit 0 inside a large number written with a comma, such as 26,0 followed by 00. It appears in converted measurements like feet, kilometers or times a dose.

modes.label: Converted measurements
modes.description: A zero in the thousands group of a converted distance or altitude figure in parentheses.
modes.example: The horizontal speed necessary to achieve low earth orbit is around 7,800 metres per second (26,0<<0>>0 ft/s).

modes.label: Counts and multiples
modes.description: A zero in the middle of a large count, such as people or multiples of a dose.

card.plain: It fires on a zero in the middle of a big rounded number like 26,000, helping the model finish the number with more zeros.
